data.body:
`main()` now issues two independent `store.list_json(...)` calls (one for `finding_observed/`, one for `finding_verdict/`). Each call independently invokes `TelemetryStore._load_tree()`, which re-fetches the branch ref, the commit, and the full recursive tree listing from GitHub — there is no caching/sharing of the already-fetched tree between the two calls. This happens unconditionally on every invocation of this script, including the generation-time call from `prepare_ai_review_context.sh` (which doesn't even use `--decisions-output`) and the publish-time call from `post_ai_review.sh`, so every AI review run now does the ref+commit+tree round trip twice instead of once.

Fix: fetch the tree once and derive both prefix listings from it, e.g. add a `TelemetryStore` method that accepts multiple prefixes and shares one `_load_tree()` call, or expose/cache the loaded `GitTree` for reuse within a single process invocation.
